items.question: Can I book for someone else?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! You can book a puja for family members, friends, or anyone you care about. Just mention their details in the booking form and we'll coordinate everything accordingly.

items.question: How is the price calculated?
items.answer: BookMyPooja has transperant pricing and packages for each puja type based on culture and location. You'll know the exact cost before confirming your booking.

items.question: Will the pandit speak my language?
items.answer: Yes! Our pandits are fluent in Hindi, English, and various regional languages including Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Marathi, and Bengali. We'll match you with a pandit who speaks your preferred language.

items.question: Can you do online pujas via video?
items.answer: Absolutely! We offer live online pujas via video call where our pandit performs the ceremony while you participate from home. This is perfect for urgent needs or when physical presence isn't possible.

items.question: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
items.answer: You can cancel upto 24 hours before the puja date. Cancellation charges increase as you come closer to the date. For cancellations more than 96 hours before the puja, 10% cancellation fee is applied. For cancellarions between 24 to 96 hours before the puja, 50% cancellation charges are applied. For cancellations within 24 hours, 100% cancellation charges shall be applied.

items.question: Do you provide all the puja materials?
items.answer: Yes, every package includes puja items, pandit ji Dakshina and travel charges. You may have to arrange some items at home ( called as Home preparation list ) which will be shared with you post booking confirmation by the Seva team.
